**Average (median) house price in California (2024)**  
- **Median home value:** ≈ $800 000–$850 000

> *Note:* In real‑estate statistics the term “average” is usually reported as the **median** value, which represents the middle point of all home prices in the state. The median price in California has hovered around $800 k–$850 k in recent quarters, reflecting the high cost of living and strong demand in many regions of the state.
